verdict.rationale: Stripe (the platform Terminal belongs to) ships an official Stripe CLI to build, test, and manage integrations from the terminal, documented at docs.stripe.com/cli and confirmed by probe. This is a first-party, well-documented CLI covering the broader Stripe ecosystem including Terminal integrations. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on community verification specifically praising the CLI's AI-native workflow fit, and Terminal-specific CLI command examples.
